feature_notes:
First installable alpha of the canonical Rust spreadsheet engine.

Newly available as crates.io packages: bounded sparse XLSX streaming, exact scalar and shared/rich string values, numeric/ISO dates, style catalogs, formula/cache metadata, sequential creation, sparse owned models, guarded original-package cell edits, worksheet views and printing settings.

This release does not claim complete openpyxl feature coverage. M2 and M4 remain in progress; complete structural editing, advanced feature graphs and full adapter compatibility remain staged. Resource allowances constrain managed storage, not total process RSS.

Rust 1.99 is required. See docs/roadmap.md and docs/milestones.md for capability boundaries and benchmark evidence.
